newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fletcher Building tumbles after result.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher Building tumbles after result.

text.p: Shares in Fletcher Challenge Building Division fell early on Wednesday after the company reported a sharp fall in first half net profit to NZ$53 million from $77 million.
FCL Building was 17 cents down at $4.30 after 35 minutes' trade.
Fletcher Energy was the only share in the FCL group to trade higher, adding two cents to $3.85 after falling 12 on Tuesday.
Overall market turnover was light as analysts digested the results.

"I have only seen the bottom line numbers, But off the top of my head the building number is a bit of a surprise, certainly lower than we were thinking, but there could be abnormals or something in there. The paper one is probably a bit higher than I was expecting and the forest one is more or less in line," said John Cairns at Cavill White Securities.
The Building result included NZ$29 million in depreciation, $3.0 million in depletions and $2.0 million in amortisation.
Merrill Lynch was forecasting a net profit of NZ$57 million for Building, while other forecasts had ranged up to $75 million.
